name: boss-9-t
about: The title's containment hall: a lighter build of boss-9 (the same source, rig and clips), for a boss seen at the middle distance in its stasis pod. Boss Rush: Undue Influencer (a masked puppeteer with marionette crosses on strings). Tripo H3.1 from concept boss09-influencer-sd-0; rigged by Tripo (rig v1.0, biped); eight clips retargeted from Trip
bar: the game's one quality bar (2026-11-17): a figure seen at middle distance (the title's pods): 1024 px colour, 512 px other maps, about 20K triangles
